_doc: AUTHORED ground-truth placement modes for step formations. SOURCE = measured-usage (the artist's/user's intended use). This file is the AUTHORITY for placementMode; a future reviewed geometry classifier may cross-check these values but must NEVER override them — on disagreement it logs a warning naming the formation, nothing more.

_modes.interior: free-standing; the whole perimeter is closed/steppable; may sit mid-room.
_modes.room_entrance: has an OPEN side; must abut a real doorway, open side aligned to it, connecting room at the elevation the open side ascends/descends to. NEVER mid-room.
_modes.wall_abutting: has a flat/blank BACK; the back seats flush against the MIDDLE of a wall span, stepped/front faces the room. NEVER free-standing, NEVER at a doorway.

stairConnectors._doc: STAIR CONNECTOR DIRECTORY: prefabs in `directory` are candidate staircase connectors. Port contracts below are reviewed legacy reference data; do not treat them as a generated measurement path.
stairConnectors._primaryStairDoc: The designated 1-level straight stair. Code reads THIS, not a hard path. The connection gate validates this prefab re-derives entry@L0 + exit@L1 ports.
stairConnectors._weightsDoc: Optional per-stair relative weight override by prefab name. Unlisted contracted stairs use the rise default falloff; names are not eligibility.

contracts._doc: Legacy reference data. These records are legacy reference data only. A future reviewed contract system should replace them.

_keySide: Local side (north/east/south/west) that must face the target. openSide for room_entrance; backSide for wall_abutting; null for interior. 'discover' = run the one-time per-side vertical-face-height diagnostic and bake the constant here.
_confidence: high = user-stated intent or measured-confirmed. proposed = inferred from measured kind + the working raised-dais behavior; RATIFY. review = ambiguous SetPiece, classify later.

concave.note: open curved C; user-confirmed open; geometry agrees south:open.

concave_octagonal_small.note: closed octagonal pit; geometry agrees interior.

convex_railing_short.note: raised railed island/balcony; RATIFY (could be wall_abutting).

step_throne_02.note: baked: sideHeights N=0.33 E=0.712 S=0 W=0.712 -> open front S (min) -> back = opposite = N.

step_room_width.note: name implies spans a wall; RATIFY (could be room_entrance full-width step bank).

setPieces_review._note: Tall SetPieces — not in active placement yet. Classify when integrated.
